name: Password reset link over unencrypted HTTP
description:
The password reset link sent to the user, which carries the reset token, uses the http:// scheme. Opening it sends the token in cleartext, where anyone on the network path can read it and use it before the user does.

This row is burpsy's own: Burp's issue catalogue has no password-reset rows.
remediation: Build reset links with https:// from a configured base URL, and serve the reset page only over HTTPS with HTTP Strict Transport Security.

references.title: OWASP WSTG: Testing for Weak Password Change or Reset Functionalities (WSTG-ATHN-09)

vulnerabilityClassifications.title: CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
